string.text: Hide selected PDA / Dynamic News classes. Checked = filtered out (except Highlight name, which is on when checked). Story and quest tips are not touched. This is an extra filter on top of GAMMA's Dynamic News page.
Yellow-wraps your character name in any PDA / news tip (Dynamic News, send_tip, tasks, xpda). Port of Eroktics QoL highlight.

Hides ambient Dynamic News from factions that are enemies of yours: their SOS, loot, artifact, trade, and combat nets, plus open-channel tips about or from them. Merc net is open in DNM; loners who are enemies still get dropped. Direct story/quest tips still come through.
Suppresses Personal Adjustable Waypoint "Mission complete: Placed Waypoint" / fail PDA news when you reach or clear a marker. Setting a waypoint still uses the normal new-mission tip.
Hides "I just saw a stalker shoot a bloodsucker near the farm in Cordon" style radio. Fired when a nearby stalker kills a mutant (Seen / gossip mutant death).
Hides "I just saw a stalker shoot a bandit..." and "a mutant got him" witness radio when a stalker dies to another stalker or a mutant. Does not hide SOS calls for help.
Hides nearby-fight chatter and offline battle reports ("gunfire near the depot", "a fight broke out at..."). Same class as Dynamic News nearby activity.
Hides the grey "Dead: Name, Loner. Found near..." listings when someone dies to a stalker, mutant, or emission. Off in stock GAMMA Dynamic News; this only matters if those notices are on.
Hides periodic faction roll-ups of who died to stalkers, mutants, or blowouts (ReportDeathBy*). Not the live witness lines above.
Hides "I found a body near..." tips when a stalker reports a corpse.
Hides radio when someone finishes a wounded stalker (KillWounded).
Hides "I looted a sweet rifle off him" / "he had an exoskeleton" radio when a stalker strips a corpse (GossipLoot).
Hides "I found a stash near..." and replies to those finds (FoundStash).
Hides "I bought a Fort from Sidorovich" style trade brags (BoughtItems).
Hides "just had my rifle tuned" / technician upgrade brags (UpgradedItems).
Hides "I pulled an artifact from the anomaly..." and replies to those finds.
Hides hired-companion flavor about you, the map, or their life. Does not hide companion orders or task tips.
Hides the periodic random-zone banter pool (SpamRandom). No gameplay info.
Hides "looks like rain coming" / weather-change radio.
Hides dawn / dusk / night flavor lines (GossipTime).
Hides general "the Zone is restless / anomalies acting up" reports (ReportZoneActivity).
Hides blowout-over, next-emission, and surge-death reaction radio. Does not hide the engine emission siren or countdown.
Hides "zombified stalker wandering near..." sighting lines and replies.
Hides military heli callouts on the PDA (RadioInHeli).
Hides periodic faction-net status / territory reports (ReportByFaction).
